name: bindzero
description: bind(2) to port 0 picks the port, as 2.11BSD in_pcbbind does (in_pcb.c:97), so getsockname(2) can name it before listen(2).  ftp(1) binds its data socket that way and sends the port to the server in a PORT command; with the 0 recorded it sent `PORT a,b,c,d,0,0' and vsftpd answered `500 Illegal PORT command'.  loopprobe -0 binds port 0 on the wildcard (net_op_bind's hardware arm) and on 127.0.0.1 (_Loop_BindTry): both ports must be at least 1024 and differ, and a connect to the loopback one must reach its listener, which is what tells a bound port from a reported one.
